verses.text: For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments. A Psalm of Asaph. A song. God is known in Judah; His name is great in Israel.

xrefs.text: For as I walked around and examined your objects of worship, I even found an altar with this inscription: TO AN UNKNOWN GOD. Therefore what you worship as something unknown, I now proclaim to you.
King Nebuchadnezzar, To the people of every nation and language who dwell in all the earth: May your prosperity be multiplied.

Therefore I decree that the people of any nation or language who say anything offensive against the God of Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego will be cut into pieces and their houses reduced to rubble. For there is no other god who can deliver in this way.”
Then David blessed the LORD in the sight of all the assembly and said: “May You be blessed, O LORD, God of our father Israel, from everlasting to everlasting.
The LORD has proclaimed His salvation and revealed His righteousness to the nations.

verses.text: His tent is in Salem, His dwelling place in Zion.

xrefs.text: Then Melchizedek king of Salem brought out bread and wine— since he was priest of God Most High
Cry out and sing, O citizen of Zion, for great among you is the Holy One of Israel.”
For the LORD has chosen Zion; He has desired it for His home:
But now I have chosen Jerusalem for My Name to be there, and I have chosen David to be over My people Israel.’
This Melchizedek was king of Salem and priest of God Most High. He met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings and blessed him,

verses.text: There He shattered the flaming arrows, the shield and sword and weapons of war. Selah

xrefs.text: He makes wars to cease throughout the earth; He breaks the bow and shatters the spear; He burns the shields in the fire.
Then I will strike the bow from your left hand and dash down the arrows from your right hand.
‘I will defend this city and save it for My own sake and for the sake of My servant David.’”

Then those who dwell in the cities of Israel will go out, kindle fires, and burn up the weapons— the bucklers and shields, the bows and arrows, the clubs and spears. For seven years they will use them for fuel.

Then Jehoshaphat and his people went to carry off the plunder, and they found on the bodies an abundance of goods and valuables more than they could carry away. They were gathering the plunder for three days because there was so much.

verses.text: You are resplendent with light, more majestic than mountains filled with game.

xrefs.text: [“]As for you, take up a lament for the princes of Israel
‘These four great beasts are four kings who will arise from the earth.

in order to seize the spoil and carry off the plunder, to turn a hand against the desolate places now inhabited and against a people gathered from the nations, who have acquired livestock and possessions and who live at the center of the land.’
He prowled among the lions, and became a young lion. After learning to tear his prey, he devoured men.

The first beast was like a lion, and it had the wings of an eagle. I watched until its wings were torn off and it was lifted up from the ground and made to stand on two feet like a man and given the mind of a man.

verses.text: The valiant lie plundered; they sleep their last sleep. No men of might could lift a hand.

xrefs.text: O king of Assyria, your shepherds slumber; your officers sleep. Your people are scattered on the mountains with no one to gather them.
Consider me and respond, O LORD my God. Give light to my eyes, lest I sleep in death,
While they are flushed with heat, I will serve them a feast, and I will make them drunk so that they may revel; then they will fall asleep forever and never wake up, declares the LORD.
Listen to Me, you stubborn people, far removed from righteousness:
“Then Assyria will fall, but not by the sword of man; a sword will devour them, but not one made by mortals. They will flee before the sword, and their young men will be put to forced labor.

verses.text: At Your rebuke, O God of Jacob, both horse and rider lie stunned.

xrefs.text: Then Moses and the Israelites sang this song to the LORD: “I will sing to the LORD, for He is highly exalted. The horse and rider He has thrown into the sea.
And Miriam sang back to them: “Sing to the LORD, for He is highly exalted; the horse and rider He has thrown into the sea.”
Your vine has been cut down and burned; they perish at the rebuke of Your countenance.
So Moses stretched out his hand over the sea, and at daybreak the sea returned to its normal state. As the Egyptians were retreating, the LORD swept them into the sea.
But You blew with Your breath, and the sea covered them. They sank like lead in the mighty waters.

verses.text: You alone are to be feared. When You are angry, who can stand before You?

xrefs.text: Who can withstand His indignation? Who can endure His burning anger? His wrath is poured out like fire; even rocks are shattered before Him.
Kiss the Son, lest He be angry and you perish in your rebellion, when His wrath ignites in an instant. Blessed are all who take refuge in Him.
In the council of the holy ones, God is greatly feared, and awesome above all who surround Him.
And he said in a loud voice, “Fear God and give Him glory, because the hour of His judgment has come. Worship the One who made the heavens and the earth and the sea and the springs of waters.
Who would not fear You, O King of nations? This is Your due. For among all the wise men of the nations, and in all their kingdoms, there is none like You.

verses.text: From heaven You pronounced judgment, and the earth feared and was still

xrefs.text: And the fear of God came upon all the kingdoms of the lands when they heard that the LORD had fought against the enemies of Israel.
But the LORD is in His holy temple; let all the earth be silent before Him.
Be silent before the LORD, all people, for He has roused Himself from His holy dwelling.”
From the heavens the stars fought; from their courses they fought against Sisera.

The fish of the sea, the birds of the air, the beasts of the field, every creature that crawls upon the ground, and all mankind on the face of the earth will tremble at My presence. The mountains will be thrown down, the cliffs will collapse, and every wall will fall to the ground.

verses.text: when God rose up to judge, to save all the lowly of the earth. Selah

xrefs.text: Blessed are the meek, for they will inherit the earth.
Seek the LORD, all you humble of the earth who carry out His justice. Seek righteousness; seek humility. Perhaps you will be sheltered on the day of the LORD’s anger.

but with righteousness He will judge the poor, and with equity He will decide for the lowly of the earth. He will strike the earth with the rod of His mouth and slay the wicked with the breath of His lips.
But the LORD abides forever; He has established His throne for judgment.
For the LORD takes pleasure in His people; He adorns the afflicted with salvation.

verses.text: Even the wrath of man shall praise You; with the survivors of wrath You will clothe Yourself.

xrefs.text: For the Scripture says to Pharaoh: “I raised you up for this very purpose, that I might display My power in you, and that My name might be proclaimed in all the earth.”
If those days had not been cut short, nobody would be saved. But for the sake of the elect, those days will be cut short.
At this, Nebuchadnezzar was filled with rage, and the expression on his face changed toward Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego. He gave orders to heat the furnace seven times hotter than usual,
The kings of the earth take their stand and the rulers gather together against the Lord and against His Anointed One.’

The nations were enraged, and Your wrath has come. The time has come to judge the dead and to reward Your servants the prophets, as well as the saints and those who fear Your name, both small and great— and to destroy those who destroy the earth.

verses.text: Make and fulfill your vows to the LORD your God; let all the neighboring lands bring tribute to Him who is to be feared.

xrefs.text: When you make a vow to God, do not delay in fulfilling it, because He takes no pleasure in fools. Fulfill your vow.
Sacrifice a thank offering to God, and fulfill your vows to the Most High.
Because of Your temple at Jerusalem kings will bring You gifts.
In the council of the holy ones, God is greatly feared, and awesome above all who surround Him.

If the God of my father, the God of Abraham and the Fear of Isaac, had not been with me, surely by now you would have sent me away empty-handed. But God has seen my affliction and the toil of my hands, and last night He rendered judgment.”

verses.text: He breaks the spirits of princes; He is feared by the kings of the earth.

xrefs.text: “I have cut off the nations; their corner towers are destroyed. I have made their streets deserted with no one to pass through. Their cities are laid waste, with no man, no inhabitant.
Wail, for the Day of the LORD is near; it will come as destruction from the Almighty.
“Kings and their armies flee in haste; she who waits at home divides the plunder.

and the LORD sent an angel who annihilated every mighty man of valor and every leader and commander in the camp of the king of Assyria. So he withdrew to his own land in disgrace. And when he entered the temple of his god, some of his own sons struck him down with the sword.
Then He rebukes them in His anger, and terrifies them in His fury:
